note: Hand labels for every group of REAL CDSCO NSQ rows (Mar 2025, Jul-Sep 2026) that share a batch code after removing spaces/punctuation, or after collapsing look-alike characters. Each group is the same batch code written down by different labs or in different months. Labelled by reading product, maker, expiry and lab side by side, before running the matcher. same = the same physical batch (should flag). different = a different product that reuses the code (must not flag). ambiguous = cannot tell from the text (should go to a human). The group list is generated by eval/real-eval.js; it fails if a group is unlabelled.
